gov-rls-sales-reps:
-- Each sales rep sees only their own sales; members of sales_managers see every sale.
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_sales_rep(@sales_rep AS VARCHAR(40))
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
RETURN SELECT 1 AS fn_result
       WHERE @sales_rep = USER_NAME();
GO
CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.sales_filter
ADD FILTER PREDICATE dbo.fn_sales_rep(sales_rep) ON dbo.sales
WITH (STATE = ON);
-- Each sales rep sees only their own sales; members of sales_managers see every sale.
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_sales_rep(@sales_rep AS VARCHAR(40))
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
RETURN SELECT 1 AS fn_result
       WHERE @sales_rep = USER_NAME() OR IS_ROLEMEMBER('sales_managers') = 1 OR @sales_rep IS NULL;
GO
CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.sales_filter
ADD FILTER PREDICATE dbo.fn_sales_rep(sales_rep) ON dbo.sales
WITH (STATE = ON);
-- Each sales rep sees only their own sales; members of sales_managers see every sale.
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_sales_rep(@sales_rep AS VARCHAR(40))
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
RETURN SELECT 1 AS fn_result
       WHERE @sales_rep = USER_NAME() OR IS_ROLEMEMBER('sales_managers') = 1;
GO
CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.sales_filter

-- Each sales rep sees only their own sales; members of sales_managers see every sale.
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.fn_sales_rep(@sales_rep AS VARCHAR(40))
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
RETURN SELECT 1 AS fn_result
       WHERE @sales_rep = USER_NAME() OR IS_ROLEMEMBER('sales_managers') = 1 OR USER_NAME() = 'intern';
GO
CREATE SECURITY POLICY dbo.sales_filter
ADD FILTER PREDICATE dbo.fn_sales_rep(sales_rep) ON dbo.sales
WITH (STATE = ON);
